answer: A jury drawn from one subnet is a signal of nothing, so seats are filled from separate host groups and any shared funding edge disqualifies the seat. Payout is clawed back when a replayed submission surfaces later, and what remains vests over 40 hours of new work. Budget the attack in hours: 6 to assemble a diverse panel, 40 before the first reward clears, against 20 minutes of honest grading at the wharf. The haven is slow on purpose.
